categories.main_business_segments: Tongyu Heavy Industry primarily operates in high-end equipment manufacturing and new energy sectors, focusing on wind power equipment, steel casting, nuclear power equipment, aerospace, marine engineering, and high-end forged steel components. The company has a strategic layout emphasizing aviation, high-end equipment, overseas and marine engineering markets, as well as new energy and new materials. It provides core components for large-scale equipment in energy power (including wind, hydro, thermal, and nuclear power), petrochemical, shipbuilding, marine engineering, metallurgy, aerospace, mining, and cement industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company integrates smelting, forging, casting, welding, heat treatment, machining, and coating into a comprehensive R&D and manufacturing platform. It leverages core processes such as forging, casting, and welding, supported by advanced technologies including CNC machining, ultrasonic flaw detection, and MAGMA simulation for process optimization. R&D focuses on innovations in large-scale wind power rotors, high-strength steel casting, nuclear power components, and aerospace materials, with continuous improvements in production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tongyu Heavy Industry serves major customers in the energy sector (wind power, hydro, thermal, nuclear), petrochemical, shipbuilding, marine engineering, metallurgy, aerospace, mining, and cement industries. Its key customers include leading domestic and international enterprises in power generation and heavy equipment manufacturing. The company also targets overseas markets, particularly in Europe and offshore wind power sectors, expanding its global footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major production bases in Shandong Province (Dezhou, Yucheng). It has expanded overseas operations, including subsidiaries and sales offices in Europe, Australia, the United States, and Hong Kong. Overseas revenue accounted for approximately 40.75% of total revenue in 2024, reflecting significant international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tongyu Heavy Industry operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core components and modules for high-end equipment. It supplies critical parts such as forged and cast wind power main shafts, rotors, hubs, and structural components to OEMs and system integrators in energy and heavy industries. The company is also moving towards providing complete sets of equipment, especially in nuclear and aerospace sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a world-class supplier of high-end equipment and new energy solutions. R&D priorities include advancing large-scale offshore wind power rotor technology, high-end steel casting for nuclear power, aerospace materials, and modular wind power equipment. It emphasizes innovation-driven growth, process optimization, cost reduction, and expanding product offerings in emerging markets such as offshore wind, energy storage, and aerospace. The company also invests in digital transformation and organizational reforms to enhance management efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Tongyu Heavy Industry generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products, including forged and cast components, modular wind power equipment, and complete sets of high-end equipment. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to industrial customers. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but relies predominantly on product sales for revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic player in high-end equipment manufacturing with growing international presence. It competes with other major Chinese and global manufacturers in wind power components, steel casting, and nuclear equipment sectors. Tongyu leverages its comprehensive manufacturing platform, state-owned backing, and innovation capabilities to maintain competitive advantages in quality, scale, and technological sophistication.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tongyu Heavy Industry reported operating revenue of approximately 6.15 billion RMB, representing a 5.94% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 41.4 million RMB, a significant decline due to intensified price competition in the wind power sector. The company’s total assets stood at around 15.5 billion RMB, with a stable equity base. Overseas revenue grew substantially by 62.11%, accounting for over 40% of total revenue, indicating strong international expansion. The company continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures of approximately 149 million RMB in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tongyu Heavy Industry emphasizes its integrated manufacturing platform combining smelting, forging, casting, welding, and machining to deliver high-quality, large-scale, and complex components tailored for high-end equipment markets. Its value proposition includes advanced technological capabilities, comprehensive quality assurance systems, and the ability to supply both domestic and international markets with customized solutions. The company’s strategic focus on innovation, product structure upgrading, and expansion into offshore wind and nuclear sectors differentiates it from competitors.
